Operational Features

Engineered for pace and profit

Every bottleneck in a restaurant or club costs you margin. THE OAK CLUB accelerates table turns, stops beverage shrinkage, and closes shifts accurately.

Floor & Table Management

Interactive bird's eye floor plan with live table occupancy, reservation tags, and VIP seating status.

High-Speed Mobile POS

Fast handheld order taking for waiters with automated modifier prompts (temperatures, mixers, dietary notes).

Kitchen Display & KOT

Color-coded order preparation stages with countdown timers and course-by-course firing controls.

High-Volume Bar Station

Fast-tap cocktails, bottle service tracking, running patron tabs, and quick split-bill settlements.

Real-Time Stock Depletion

Pours and ingredient portions automatically deduct from warehouse stock with zero manual end-of-night counting.

Vendor Purchasing & Costing

Vendor catalog pricing, recipe food-cost percentage tracking, and automated reorder alerts.

Cashier & Shift Reconciliation

Blind float reconciliation, digital cash drawer control, tip pool management, and discrepancy auditing.

Staff HR & Attendance

Front-of-house and kitchen staff clock-in, overtime logs, and role-based access permissions.

Daily Revenue & P&L Reports

Item profitability matrices, hourly sales velocity, beverage versus food ratios, and tax summaries.

Synchronized Venue Operations
